title: 第13章 女帝崛起之路第14章 娶她娶她娶她
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
【对于叶良言的想法。
【你认为有点小题大做。
【眼下时局将乱。
【只要皇帝一死，九龙夺嫡会演变到何种地步，谁也说不准。
【而李若望又是皇帝最疼爱的女儿。
【自然是期望叶良言能够护她一生平安。
【面对你的说法，叶良言没有吭声。
【随后，你又将今日在花园中，与李若望的谈话诉说了一遍。
【叶良言眼中的疑惑更加浓郁几分。
【五十年之期？】
【为何要等待如此之久？】
【眼看叶良言又陷入沉思之中。
【你也懒得啰嗦，转身回房休息。
【并在第二天一大早，果断离开了大乾王国。
【开始你新一轮的大爱之旅。
【接下来很长的一段时间。
【你在修真界内肆意妄为。
【攻略对象不仅仅止步于正道宗门，就连魔门圣女，你也一样没有放过。
【这样的做法。
【使得你在正邪两道名声大噪。

【无数痴情男修，都视你为生死大敌。
【更有甚者，对你展开了联手追杀。
content_en:
[Thoughts about Ye Liangyan.
[You think it’s a bit of a fuss.
[The current situation is going to be chaotic.
[As long as the emperor dies, no one can say to what extent the Nine Dragons Seizing of Heirs will evolve.
[And Li Ruowang is the emperor's most beloved daughter.
[Naturally, I hope Ye Liangyan can protect her safety throughout her life.
[In the face of your statement, Ye Liangyan did not say anything.
[Then you recounted the conversation you had with Li Ruowang in the garden today.
[The confusion in Ye Liangyan's eyes became even more intense.
[Fifty-year period? 】
[Why do you have to wait so long? 】
[Seeing Ye Liangyan fell into deep thought again.
[You are too lazy to talk, so you turn around and go back to your room to rest.
[And early the next morning, he decisively left the Daqian Kingdom.
【Start your new journey of great love.
[A long period of time follows.
[You are acting recklessly in the world of cultivation.
[The target of the strategy is not only limited to the righteous sect, but also the saint of the demon sect, you have not let go.
【Such an approach.
[It will make you famous in both good and evil realms.
[Countless infatuated male cultivators regard you as their life and death enemy.
[What's more, they launched a joint hunt for you.
